mechanism: One true fine ancestry path per deduplicated original fine ID. a,b,c are original three LN outputs. Shared phi(x)=GELU(Linear_C_to_C(x)). q=phi(a+b+c)-phi(a+b)-phi(a+c)-phi(b+c)+phi(a)+phi(b)+phi(c)-phi(0). Fine delta=q; middle and coarse delta are direct equal means over their true fine paths. Original raw skip, HCG, CSORT and single inst_feats path unchanged.
structural_difference: Eight shared Boolean-lattice subset evaluations and signed inclusion-exclusion replace three independent FFNs. No persistent node/edge state, ordered two-stage composition, pair attention or factor-incidence wedge graph.

closest.hypothesis: One shared original-ancestry triplet factor jointly transforms fine/middle/coarse inputs and returns direct fine plus fixed-mean upper messages before unchanged raw skips/HCG; whole-graph alternative, efficacy unknown.

A shared binary nonlinear operator composed along fine-middle-coarse and fine-coarse-middle private paths, then contrasted before direct fine-path means, may provide a useful ancestor-order-sensitive alternative to independent per-scale FFNs. This is an ancestry-path whole-graph fork, not new information, diagnosed bottleneck, APF repair or proven novelty/efficacy.

Synchronous full-neighbor nonlinear node-state composition over the original true-supported three-level forest for each component exact tree diameter may provide a useful whole-DAG alternative before unchanged raw skips/HCG/singleinst. Ordinary GNN-family efficacy/novelty/task deficit remain UNKNOWN; this does not repair PES or prove new information.

This is an ordinary edge-state message-passing family hypothesis; task deficit, efficacy and novelty remain UNKNOWN.

Task efficacy and novelty UNKNOWN.

Learned nonlinear cross-bank predict/update lifting may expose two detail banks and a coarse bank to the original three FFNs before reverse-order synthesis and the unchanged inst_feats delivery.
